population: Public itch.io project-account administration and ownership-change processes, not observed teams or actual publisher accounts
unit: Feature or source-stated policy condition; no individual seller, legal person, transaction, or paid order observed
period: 2014 administrator launch, 2026 moderated ownership-transfer support statement, checked October 27 2026
sample_frame: Official game-admin feature announcement, moderated itch.io support case, creator bundle documentation and platform terms
practical_release_controls: Choose and document owner account and the rights holder before publishing.
Approve only necessary collaborators and retain a record of delegated access.
Keep payment recipient, cost sharing and IP ownership agreements separate from edit access.
Contact official support for account-owner migration; do not promise timing or success.
Do not delete and recreate a paid game page as a substitute for ownership transfer or expect previous entitlements to move automatically.
limits: The 2014 administration announcement is historical; the full 2026 authorization matrix was not inspected in a live account.
Moderator advice from a 2026 individual case is narrower than a comprehensive transfer policy.
No account login, project mutation, purchase, payment, personal data or legal ownership transfer occurred.
